name: Tun Ali Hati
bio: Ali Hati brings Ahmad’s requests without claiming authority to set a fee or settle the merchant’s claim himself.
notes: fact: Brown has him ride with Ahmad at the defense and refuse another master before being killed on Mahmud’s order; he is not Tun Fatimah’s first husband (Brown chs. XXII–XXIII, pp. 159–160, 166–170)
gameplay: His trips to the harbour are fictional, not a port appointment (people-factions.md §2)
